common_invariants: Return values in rows are main C-int return values; shell status is its low8bits. Do not translate raw -1 into -errno except branches explicitly doing so.
failed/checked_fail diagnostics are stdout; perror/explicit action diagnostics are stderr.
No whole-function errno guarantee; close/free may affect TLS errno. Captured return precedence is source-established.
FD ownership covers only opens actually successful; common main close executes once after fd_action, bypass routes own their own opens if any.
A caller-owned pointer passing to ioctl/public API establishes a synchronous borrow requirement, not proof of actual handler retention behavior. Those backend contracts remain to be joined.
Source presence does not establish original required supported set. Original membership, real provider operations, current-free/source/native gates remain UNKNOWN until actual owner input.
No undefined overflow/baseline, held raw ioctl, device/sysfs/native operation or monitor lookup is proposed.
